selection_rule.score: flat median over all prescribed run cells of final_float64_rounded_loss / canonical_product_plan_loss_float64
selection_rule.normalization: Each run is normalized by its own frozen instance's product-plan loss; equal repetition counts per instance prevent scale or replication weighting differences.
selection_rule.run_failure: missing run, status failed, mismatched inputs, nonfinite final score, invalid rounded output, or missing required final float64 evidence
selection_rule.candidate_failure: Any required run failure makes the candidate ineligible and its score positive infinity; failures cannot be hidden by the median.
selection_rule.inner_failure_policy: Completed runs with inner iteration caps or native warnings remain eligible if their actual rounded outputs validate. Retain and report all failures, residuals, warnings and unknown native inner counts.
selection_rule.native_early_stop: A valid native final output before the nominal budget remains eligible; report actual solver time and missing later checkpoint windows.
selection_rule.tie_break: exact numeric equality, then lexicographic candidate ID; no arbitrary tolerance
selection_rule.all_ineligible: Emit no_valid_setting, stop final-manifest generation for review, and never select a fallback.
selection_rule.heldout_access: Finalize and archive selection before generating or running held-out final manifests; no parameter changes based on held-out values.
